name: Imperial Citadel of Thang Long
kicker: The UNESCO citadel in Ba Dinh
summary: Give the citadel a morning of its own. UNESCO lists an 11th-century Ly citadel on a 7th-century fortress, inscribed in 2010. An adult ticket is 100,000 VND from 1 January 2025, and the gate is 8:00 to 17:00 every day. This ticket is not the mausoleum ticket.
heroCaption: Doan Mon Gate at the Imperial Citadel

notice.title: A different gate from the mausoleum
notice.body: The citadel ticket does not include the Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum. The mausoleum has its own hours, and its fee is disputed between a free official FAQ and a 40,000 VND tourism figure.

body: Walk Doan Mon Gate and the flag tower inside the UNESCO sector. The World Heritage listing, from 2010, describes an 11th-century Ly citadel built on a 7th-century fortress. The visit length was not published. Check on arrival.

The operator’s ticket page, from 1 January 2025, charges an adult 100,000 VND. Vietnamese students aged 16 and over, and Vietnamese visitors aged 60 and over, pay 50,000 VND with identification. Under 16 is free. The gate is 8:00 to 17:00 every day. The address is 19c Hoang Dieu, Ba Dinh. A ride from Hoan Kiem has no published minute count.

figures.caption: The flag tower, with the flag kept in the frame
figures.alt: The flag tower of Hanoi with the national flag flying

gettingThere: The operator address is 19c Hoang Dieu, Ba Dinh. UNESCO publishes the coordinates N21 2 15.072, E105 50 19.043. No drive time from Hoan Kiem was on those pages. Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Hoan Kiem
legs.body: By car or motorbike to 19c Hoang Dieu. The minutes are check on arrival.

closed: No weekly closing day is printed on the operator ticket page.
admissionNote: From 1 January 2025: adult 100,000 VND. Vietnamese students 16 and over, and Vietnamese people 60 and over, 50,000 VND with identification. Under 16 free.
